it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 02/04/2026, na Câmara de Vereadores, depois que Emerson Maas renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on April 2, 2026, at the City Council, after Mayor Emerson Maas resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
